# introduction
Read the guidelines at .github/copilot-instructions. You have the role of reviewer, you will write plans for analyzer and then start an analyzer subagent to carry out that those plans. It is up to you how to schedule and send off the tasks to analyzer subagent(s), but keep the work of each subagent isolated. Be careful of recompiling executables which might be in use by another program. If there is a chance a file is being edited or executable ran or will soon-to-be ran by anther subagent, then wait until that subagent's task has concluded. For analysis production use 20-30 threads, for skimming use 5 threads for mc and 10 threads for data.

# private pythia+madgraph regeneration
The previous task found that the issue with upgrading the generator configuration from LO to NLO stemed from pdf usage being different between 5.02 TeV (NNPDF31_nnlo LHAID=303600) and 8.16 TeV (NNPDF23_lo LHAID=230000). In the previous task this was fixed by using the same pdf setting for each energy but its not clear if the nnlo or lo pdf was chosen. Anyway we want to investigate the closure with the official 5.02TeV pp sample using both pdf choices and more stats. Produce 100k new events using the private mc workflow for
 - 5.02 TeV (NNPDF31_nnlo LHAID=303600)
 - 5.02 TeV (NNPDF23_lo LHAID=230000)
 - 8.16 TeV (NNPDF31_nnlo LHAID=303600)
 - 8.16 TeV (NNPDF23_lo LHAID=230000)
Make comparison plots overlaying 5.02 TeV with the official 5.02 TeV pp MC sample for Z pT, Z eta, trk pT, track eta as is done in Plots/20260404_ppClosure. Do this for nnlo pdf and again for lo pdf. Use kinematic selection Z pT 0-500 for these plots. Log scale the Z pT axis down to 0.5. Return with the path for the comparison plots.

Next, calculate two MC-driven energy extrapolation corrections taking the ratio of Z pT spectra between different private pp energy simulations for 1) nnlo pdf setting and 2) lo pdf setting. Produce plots for the correction factor and closure of the weighting scheme in MainAnalysis/20260222_EnergyExtrapolation and return with the path.


# conclusion
Make the minimum number of edits necessary to implement functionality. Do not add superflous error statement catches or checks. 

Have the subanalyzer handoff a summary to you and you should review that summary for flaws. Update copilot instructions on the new norms detailed here and learned by you or the subanalyzer throught these tasks.
